name: Rejection Reason 55 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.

CAEV.name: Corporate Action Rejection
CAEV.definition: Corporate action pending on the financial instrument instructed.

PODU.name: Possible Duplicate
PODU.definition: Instruction has not been matched. It is a possible duplicate instruction.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

SSID.name: Standing Settlement Instruction Rejection
SSID.definition: Standing Settlement Instruction is unknown or invalid.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.
